field_mappings.partition_key: Both derive from userId; Segment fallback to anonymousId, RudderStack uses configurable partition key from destination config — when UseMessageID is true, message.messageId is used as partition key; otherwise falls back to userId (kinesismanager.go lines 86-94)
field_mappings.data_envelope: RudderStack adds rudderId, originalTimestamp, sentAt, receivedAt to the event payload envelope
field_mappings.context_library: Different SDK library identifiers — Segment uses analytics.js; RudderStack uses rudder-sdk-js
field_mappings.api_call: Both use AWS Kinesis PutRecord API with StreamName, PartitionKey, and Data fields (kinesis.PutRecordInput)
